# Atlassian

> > Atlassian provides collaboration and development tools including Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, and Sourcetree for software teams, IT organizations, and business workflows.

Atlassian is a leading enterprise software company specializing in team collaboration, project management, and version control solutions. The platform offers cloud and data center products, extensive documentation, marketplace integrations, and developer resources including Git tutorials and UI component libraries.

## Key Topics

- Jira
- Confluence
- Bitbucket
- Git
- Sourcetree
- Atlassian Marketplace
- Rovo

- Cloud Fortified

## Core Products

- [Jira | Issue & Project Tracking Software](https://atlassian.com/software/jira): Jira product page with AI agents for project tracking and collaboration
- [Atlassian Collaboration Software](https://cn.atlassian.com): Atlassian homepage (Chinese) featuring Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Rovo
- [Atlassian Marketplace](https://marketplace.atlassian.com): Atlassian Marketplace hub featuring apps like draw.io, ScriptRunner, Xray
- [Time in Status App](https://marketplace.atlassian.com/apps/1219732/time-in-status): Time in Status app by SaaSJet for Jira workflow analytics and reporting

## Documentation & Support

- [Atlassian Documentation Hub](https://confluence.atlassian.com): Main documentation hub for all Atlassian products (Cloud & Data Center)
- [Get Started with Sourcetree](https://confluence.atlassian.com/get-started-with-sourcetree): Sourcetree getting started guide for Git/Mercurial version control
- [Atlassian Account Login](https://id.atlassian.com): Atlassian account login page with JavaScript error message

## Git & Version Control Tutorials

- [How to Use Git? Tutorials & Workflows](https://atlassian.com/git): Git tutorials hub covering basics, workflows, and Bitbucket integration
- [How to Install Git?](https://atlassian.com/git/tutorials/install-git): Git installation guide for Mac OS X with Homebrew and MacPorts options
- [Git Amend & Rewriting History](https://atlassian.com/git/tutorials/rewriting-history): Git history rewriting tutorial covering amend, rebase, and reflog

## Development & Agile Resources

- [SDLC Guide](https://atlassian.com/agile/software-development/sdlc): Complete SDLC guide covering phases, models, and DevOps integration

## Developer Reference

- [AUI - Atlassian User Interface Documentation](https://aui.atlassian.com): AUI frontend library docs following Atlassian Design Guidelines
- [Markdown Syntax Guide for Bitbucket](https://confluence.atlassian.com/bitbucketserver/markdown-syntax-guide-776639995.html): Markdown syntax reference for Bitbucket Data Center documentation
